title: Worker briefs and kb-worker.md forbid making git worktrees outside the one the orchestrator gives
goal: kb-worker.md and the /kb-sprint run brief say a worker makes no git worktree of its own (a baseline run uses git stash or a scratch clone it can delete, never git worktree add), since git worktree remove is denied to agents and such a worktree is left for the operator. Answers the SP-caqrexqw close: ST-urfa4ntj's worker added _cache/scratch/ST-urfa4ntj/base for a baseline run and could not remove it.
